notes.title: It's Time to Dive: Viking Hiking is Out Now
notes.content:
Viking Hiking is Out Now!

[previewyoutube=4uA51PHdVPE;full][/previewyoutube]

We are proud to present Viking Hiking on Steam! The team gave their all to create a product that we hope will be fun and enjoyable. 

We would like to remind you that Viking Hiking is a student project created over the course of about 10 weeks by a team of 21 second-year students from Breda University of Applied Sciences. 

We would like to thank everyone who followed the development and allowed us to reach this milestone. We were able to improve the product a lot thanks to your feedback.

We sincerely hope you enjoy the game! Have a wonderful time!
